PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "L_in":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),
    "L_p":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_n":  (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L_n":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_c":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "itail":   (7e-6, 4e-6, 9e-6),
    "i2":      (28e-6, 18e-6, 32e-6),
    "cc":      (1.2e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "rzf":     (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9); vdd = 1.8
    It, I2, Ib, Cc = p["itail"], p["i2"], 2e-6, p["cc"]
    gmn, Ln = p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"]

    # NMOS current mirrors (all sized at same gm/Id, L, vds -> W ratio = current ratio)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmn, Ln, iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmn, Ln, It, vds=0.6)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmn, Ln, I2, vds=0.6)
    mnb = lut.size("n", gmn, Ln, Ib, vds=0.6)

    # PMOS mirror load and the second-stage PMOS (same density -> no systematic offset)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], It / 2, vds=0.9)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I2, vds=0.9)
    vo1 = vdd - m3.vgs

    # Input pair (body effect: source at tail node)
    vt = 0.25
    for _ in range(3):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2,
                      vds=max(vo1 - vt, 0.1), vsb=max(vt, 0.0))
        vt = vcm - m1.vgs

    # Cascode on the output PMOS (bulk tied to its own source)
    Lc = 0.5
    m6c = lut.size("p", p["gmid_c"], Lc, I2, vds=0.5)
    vsd6 = m6.vdsat + 0.1
    vtarget = vsd6 + m6c.vgs              # needed VSG of the bias diode

    # Bias diode for the cascode gate, found by bisection on gm/Id (VSG falls as gm/Id rises)
    lo, hi = 2.0, 16.0
    mbc = lut.size("p", (lo + hi) / 2, Lc, Ib, vds=vtarget)
    for _ in range(25):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        mbc = lut.size("p", mid, Lc, Ib, vds=vtarget)
        if mbc.vgs > vtarget:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid

    Rz = p["rzf"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "c6", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M6C", "vout", "vbc", "c6", "c6", m6c)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("MNB", "vbc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MBC", "vbc", "vbc", "vdd", "vdd", mbc)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # Predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    gds_top = m6.gds * m6c.gds / (m6c.gm + m6c.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m7.gds + gds_top)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm / (2 * PI * (cl + c1 * (1 + cl / Cc)))
    p3 = m6c.gm / (2 * PI * (m6.cdd + m6c.cgg))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) \
         + 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) * min(1.0, (p["rzf"] - 1) / 2)
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2 + Ib)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I2 / (cl + Cc))
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise_1k = noise_th * 4                      # rough flicker allowance
    cmrr_db = db(A1 / (m5.gds / (2 * m3.gm)))
    psrr_db = db(A1 * m6.gm / max(gds_top, 1e-15))
    psrr_db = min(psrr_db, gain_db + 20)
    swing = (vdd - vsd6 - m6c.vdsat - 0.05) - (m7.vdsat + 0.05)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "slew": slew,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "swing": swing, "settle": settle}
